summary: SmartFix Service — comprehensive backend + frontend testing PASSED. 35/35 pytest backend tests green covering auth (OTP register, login, /me, forgot/reset), categories/services (list, filter, search, detail), addresses CRUD, bookings full lifecycle (create with SMARTFIX10 coupon, UPI confirm, admin verify-payment, customer cancel), coupons list/validate/cap, provider apply → admin approve → role upgrade, admin stats (all numeric fields), RBAC (customer forbidden from admin). Frontend E2E: owner login redirects to /admin dashboard with KPIs (₹449.1 revenue, tabs Overview/Bookings/Services/Providers/Coupons/Users all present). Customer 3-step OTP registration → /home; DEV OTP 123456 hint visible; categories chip row with 8 categories + All; service cards show ₹ prices; category chip filter reduces service list (9→4); Book Now → booking form works with address selection, time slot, UPI/Cash toggle, SMARTFIX10 coupon apply (₹499→₹449.1 confirmed = 10% cap), Confirm Booking creates booking and navigates to detail with 5-step status timeline; Cancel Booking transitions to CANCELLED. Overall backend success 100%, frontend critical flows 100%.

minor.issue: reset_token is returned in response body for dev; must be removed before production.
dev_otp returned in response body for dev; must be removed before production.
today_start uses naive UTC datetime; timezone-dependent 'today' calculation may miscount in IST-based deployments (all bookings recorded in UTC).

issues: Initial Payment state defaults to CASH (green); tapping UPI updates state correctly but confirm on the review UX is fine — no bug.

action_items: (pre-prod) Strip dev_otp and reset_token from API responses before production launch.
(pre-prod) Wire real SMS provider in /api/auth/register/request-otp and /api/auth/forgot-password (mobile fallback).
(nice-to-have) Consider IST-aware 'today' bucket in /api/admin/stats so revenue_today/todays_bookings match Indian business hours.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses naive datetime.utcnow() consistently — good; no tz mixing observed.
MongoDB _id is excluded via find projections in all endpoints — correct.
bcrypt used for password hashing with 12 rounds; JWT (HS256) with iss/aud/exp verification — solid.
RBAC enforced via require_roles dependency; verified customer→admin route rejected (403).
Booking coupon math correct: 10% of ₹499 = ₹49.9 → total ₹449.1 (cap ₹200 unused for this price).
server.py is ~880 lines — approaching split threshold; consider modularizing routers (auth/catalog/bookings/admin) if it grows further.
startup uses @app.on_event which is deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handler in future refactor (not blocking).
seed_data_creation: Fresh customers were created via OTP flow (usernames like uitestNNNN, flowNNNNN). SMARTFIX10 coupon validated with amounts 1000 (₹100 discount) and 5000 (capped ₹200). A test coupon TESTNNNN was created via admin. A test service was created via admin. Test bookings created and one was cancelled and one was UPI-verified.
